newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse had record turnover in January - SBF.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse had record turnover in January - SBF.

text.p: Turnover in French shares rose to 173.39 billion francs ($31.2 billion) in February, for a record session average of 7.88 billion francs, the French stockmarkets association SBF said on Wednesday. The previous record average was 7.78 billion francs recorded in November 1996.
Last month's most active session was January 31 with 12.56 billion francs of turnover, and the least active was January 2 with 3.72 billion francs.

The CAC-40 index advanced 8.67 percent in January to all time highs. The SBF 120 rose 8.29 percent, the SBF 250 rose 8.44 percent, the Midcac rose 12.30 percent and the secondary market index gained 9.26 percent.

Transactions totalled 3,084,055 last month, the second consecutive month they topped three million, and the daily average was 140,180, slightly off December's daily average of 154,300 transactions but 38 percent above January 1996 levels.
The bourse's capitalisation on January 31 was 3,378.7 billion francs.
